headline: “The team made me feel <mark>really special.</mark>”
name: Lokesh K.
text:
Everyone was so <mark class="w">polite and welcoming</mark>!
A special thanks to Astha for all her support and for the <mark class="w">amazing demonstration</mark> of the Hyundai Creta.
The entire experience was wonderful, and the team <mark class="w">made me feel really special</mark> during the delivery of my new Creta.
Thank you for making this car-buying experience so memorable!

headline: “Problem sorted <mark>within no time.</mark>”
name: Anuradha K.
text:
The service centre is <mark class="w">very well managed</mark>. Palak at the reception was <mark class="w">very responsive</mark> and the floor manager Mr. Nizam had been <mark class="w">very helpful</mark>. <mark class="w">Problem sorted within no time</mark>
Thank you guys.
